subject: Decision criteria and ledger path for onboarding — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Suarez <anna@clearwavehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12 09:14 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + action items from today’s discovery

Anna / Tom — great to meet you both this morning. Short follow-up to capture what we committed to and to align on the vendor onboarding path so your teams can plan the PO and invoicing cadence.

TL;DR: ClearWave is comfortable with Redwood’s architecture and security posture; you need 1) confirmation of decision criteria and ECO buyer, 2) a list of procurement artifacts for vendor intake, and 3) an agreed invoicing cadence and PO format.

Notes from the call:
- Economic buyer: Anna mentioned procurement will run approvals but CFO (Tim Hargrove) signs POs — Anna to confirm exact approver email.
- Security checklist: ClearWave needs SOC2 report, data retention policy, and evidence of network isolation for Private deployments.
- Procurement intake: Purchasing prefers a single SOW + monthly invoices tied to PO number. AP needs vendor W-9 and banking details.
- Decision criteria: production latency under 100ms p50 for conversational flows, per-token unit cost target ~ $0.0008, and fallback model SLA 99.5% uptime.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short procurement questions workbook (procurement-questions.xlsx) and an initial SOW draft (redwood-sow-draft.pdf) for your review — they’re attached to this thread.

Proposed next steps (can we align on owners/dates?):
1) Anna: confirm final list of approvers for PO (by Thu 12/16).
2) Tom: share AP contact and vendor onboarding form (by Fri 12/17).
3) Redwood (Monica + Lauren): provide SOC2 snapshot, data retention note, and a clean SOW w/ billing cadence (by Mon 12/14).

If you want a one-page checklist for procurement intake, Monica can put that together. Happy to hop on a 20-minute follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachment: procurement-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: redwood-sow-draft.pdf (PDF)
From: Anna Suarez <anna@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@horizonpay.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12 12:03 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + action items from today’s discovery

Ben — thanks for the concise recap. A few clarifications from procurement side after I checked with Tim and AP: 

- Approver: Tim Hargrove (CFO) will sign POs over $50k; below that our head of procurement (Jill Price) can approve. I’ll confirm the exact emails by 12/16 as requested.
- AP contact: Tom, can you share the vendor intake form and ACH requirements? If you could also confirm whether Redwood accepts consolidated monthly invoices tied to a PO number that would speed things up.
- Security: SOC2 report is table stakes; our security team also wants confirmation that logs are retained for at least 180 days and that we can get per-request audit logs for the pilot window.

On decision criteria — the latency and cost targets look reasonable, but our Product team will formalize thresholds in the RFP. I’ll loop in legal next week for contract redlines; they typically expect our standard redline window to be two weeks.

I’ll review the SOW and procurement workbook this afternoon. Appreciate Monica and Lauren preparing the artifacts.

Anna
Anna Suarez | Head of Procurement Operations | ClearWave Health
anna@clearwavehealth.com | +1 212-555-0189
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Suarez <anna@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-13 09:42 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + action items from today’s discovery

Ben / Lauren — quick internal note before we send the packet. I’ll pull the SOC2 summary and data retention note today, and I’ll ask infra to prepare a per-request audit log sample to share with Security. Lauren, I’ll need the standard vendor banking info to include in the packet — can you confirm whether we should include routed ACH + SWIFT or just ACH?

Proposed outbound package to Anna/Tom: 
- SOC2 summary (redacted)
- Data retention policy excerpt (180 days)
- Example audit-log export (anonymized)
- SOW (finalized pricing table + monthly invoicing language)
- Vendor intake form (W-9, ACH details)

I’ll assemble the ZIP and aim to send by end of day 12/14. Ben — can you confirm the billing cadence we captured (monthly, net 30) so I can lock that in the SOW?

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel | Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Suarez <anna@clearwavehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-14 16:02 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + action items from today’s discovery

Anna / Tom — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming the plan and owners/dates so everyone has one source of truth: 

1) Anna — confirm approver emails (Tim / Jill) by 12/16.
2) Tom — share AP contact and vendor intake form (vendor W-9 and ACH requirements) by 12/17.
3) Monica & Lauren — send outbound packet with SOC2 snapshot, data retention note, audit-log sample, and final SOW by 12/14 (sent).
4) Rishi — legal will stand by for contract redlines once ClearWave confirms approver lane; Rishi will triage any exceptions within two business days of receipt.

Billing cadence: monthly invoicing tied to a PO, Net 30 payment terms. If procurement needs net 45, flag it in reply — we can handle on a deal-by-deal basis but want to capture it now.

Next touch: Ben to schedule a 20-min procurement alignment call the week of 12/20 if needed. Otherwise, we’ll proceed with the packet and wait for the approver list + AP form before sending SOW to Legal.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Ben
